answer_1.quote: Informative text summarization aims to shorten a long piece of text while preserving its main message.

answer_2.quote: We use three automatic evaluation metrics to evaluate our models. The first is ROUGE ... the second ... FactCC ... and ... QAGS.

answer_4.quote: three annotators from Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) are asked to judge which is more factually correct based on the source document.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to judge which summary in a pair is more factually correct based on the source document.
